workload: 20,000 short HTML paragraphs (about 4.4MB), the shape of a saved page classic file loading turns into agent context.
notes: BeautifulSoup builds a Tag for every element, then get_text() copies the text out; tracemalloc peak is 28.7MB against about 4.3MB of returned text, so a streaming extract that matches get_text() (script and style included, no added separators) can drop the tree. Overlap: no commit on this file on upstream master since 2026-10-12; open PRs including those with more than 100 files do not touch it; dexhunter PRs 14013, 13749, 13676 and 13478 touch backend json.py, truncate.py and prompt.py only; no open issue says this module is being moved. Spread is (max-min)/median over warmup plus 5 traced calls.

workload: YAML document with 5,000 records under one rows key (about 280KB), a config or data export.
notes: yaml.load(SafeLoader) composes a node per scalar and holds that graph together with the constructed dicts; peak is 15.9MB while the live objects afterwards are a few MB and str() of them is 309KB. Constructing ordinary mappings, lists and scalars without retaining the composer graph keeps the same Python value and the same str(). Overlap: file untouched on upstream master since 2026-10-12, not in open PR diffs (large PRs checked in full), not in dexhunter PRs 14013/13749/13676/13478, and not named by an open refactor issue. Spread is (max-min)/median over warmup plus 5 traced calls.

workload: An 8,000-paragraph .docx of ordinary prose, a long report handed to the classic file loader.
notes: python-docx builds an OOXML element tree and a paragraph object per paragraph, then concatenates paragraph text with no separator. Peak is 3.7MB against 0.96MB of returned text. Reading w:t text from the package XML into that same concatenation drops the object model and keeps the string. Overlap: file untouched on upstream master since 2026-10-12, not in open PR diffs (large PRs checked in full), not in dexhunter PRs 14013/13749/13676/13478, and not named by an open refactor issue. workload: A 16MB .log with no null bytes, the unknown-extension path decode_textual_file checks before falling back to text.
notes: The function file.read()s the whole file into one bytes object only to test for a null byte, so peak matches the file size (16,777,216 bytes plus allocator overhead). A chunked scan returns the same bool and keeps one chunk. decode_textual_file calls this for extensions it does not know, including code and logs. Overlap: file untouched on upstream master since 2026-10-12, not in open PR diffs (large PRs checked in full), not in dexhunter PRs 14013/13749/13676/13478, and not named by an open refactor issue. Spread is (max-min)/median over warmup plus 5 traced calls; all five peaks matched.
